list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM runs UNION SELECT environment FROM schedule_settings ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Leave Request Agent
panels.description: Latest evaluation for this agent in the selected environment; unlike the summary charts, this card is not limited by the time range. Pass: all completed metrics pass and no critical business rule fails. Fail: a completed metric or critical rule fails. Error: a metric could not be evaluated. Score is the mean of completed metric scores; skipped metrics are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(r.verdict,'No data') AS "Status",CASE WHEN r.finished_at IS NULL THEN 'No evaluation yet' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '1 minute' THEN 'Evaluated: just now' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '1 hour' THEN 'Evaluated: ' || floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - r.finished_at)) / 60)::int || ' min ago' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '24 hours' THEN 'Evaluated: ' || floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - r.finished_at)) / 3600)::int || ' h ago' ELSE 'Evaluated: ' || to_char(r.finished_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') END AS "Checked",'Case: ' || COALESCE(left(r.case_id,24) || CASE WHEN length(r.case_id)>24 THEN '…' ELSE '' END,'—') AS "Case",'Score: ' || COALESCE(round(r.score::numeric,3)::text,'—') AS "Score",'Total: ' || COALESCE(round((r.duration_ms/1000.0)::numeric,3)::text || ' s','—') AS "Total",r.run_id AS "Run ID",r.dify_log_url AS "Dify log" FROM (VALUES (1)) seed(n) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT verdict,finished_at,case_id,score,duration_ms,run_id,dify_log_url FROM runs WHERE kind='evaluation' AND agent='leave' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY started_at DESC,run_id DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true

panels.title: Today's scheduled evaluation batches
panels.description: Each dot is an evaluation batch scheduled today in Vietnam time (00:00–24:00). Bottom to top: Missed = overdue after the grace period; Waiting = before the scheduled time; Pending = due and still within the grace period; Error = a case failed or the batch finished with missing results; Complete = all expected cases finished without errors. The chart data also retains completed, expected, and error case counts.

targets.rawSql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS day_start), batches AS (SELECT e.scheduled_for,e.environment,COALESCE(b.completed_cases,0) AS completed_cases,cardinality(e.cases) AS expected_cases,COALESCE(b.failed_cases,0) AS error_cases,CASE WHEN b.status='completed' AND COALESCE(b.failed_cases,0)=0 AND COALESCE(b.completed_cases,0)>=cardinality(e.cases) THEN 4 WHEN COALESCE(b.failed_cases,0)>0 OR b.status IN ('partial','error','failed') OR (b.status='completed' AND COALESCE(b.completed_cases,0)<cardinality(e.cases)) THEN 1 WHEN now()>e.scheduled_for+e.grace_minutes*interval '1 minute' THEN 0 WHEN now()<e.scheduled_for THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS status_code FROM expected_evaluation_batches e LEFT JOIN evaluation_batch_progress b ON b.environment=e.environment AND b.scheduled_for=e.scheduled_for WHERE e.environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND (e.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date=(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date), chart_points AS (SELECT scheduled_for,CASE status_code WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 3 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 4 THEN 4 END::double precision AS status,status_code::double precision AS color,environment,completed_cases,expected_cases,error_cases FROM batches UNION ALL SELECT day_start,NULL::double precision,NULL::double precision,NULL::text,NULL::int,NULL::int,NULL::int FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT day_start+interval '1 day',NULL::double precision,NULL::double precision,NULL::text,NULL::int,NULL::int,NULL::int FROM bounds) SELECT scheduled_for AS "Scheduled (VN)",status AS "Status",color AS "Color",environment AS "Environment",completed_cases AS "Completed cases",expected_cases AS "Expected cases",error_cases AS "Error cases" FROM chart_points ORDER BY scheduled_for

panels.title: Overall verdict distribution
panels.description: Distribution of Pass, Fail, and Error across evaluation runs matching the filters. Percentage = runs with a verdict divided by all runs with these three verdicts. Pass meets all completed metrics and critical rules; Fail has a failed metric or critical rule; Error indicates an evaluation or metric execution error.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE verdict='PASS') AS "Pass",count(*) FILTER(WHERE verdict='FAIL') AS "Fail",count(*) FILTER(WHERE verdict='ERROR') AS "Error" FROM runs WHERE kind='evaluation' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Verdicts by agent
panels.description: Counts of Pass, Fail, and Error evaluation runs for each agent in the selected filters. The bars show run counts, not average scores. The stacked segments add up to the agent's total runs with a verdict.

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent AS "Agent",count(*) FILTER(WHERE verdict='PASS') AS "Pass",count(*) FILTER(WHERE verdict='FAIL') AS "Fail",count(*) FILTER(WHERE verdict='ERROR') AS "Error" FROM runs WHERE kind='evaluation' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY agent ORDER BY agent

panels.title: Verdicts by day
panels.description: Each dot is the daily count of Pass, Fail, or Error evaluation runs, grouped by start date in Vietnam time. Environment, agent, and time-range filters apply. Dots are not connected because a missing day is not a measured intermediate value.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day',started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' AS time,initcap(verdict) AS metric,count(*)::double precision AS value FROM runs WHERE kind='evaluation' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Score trend
panels.description: Each dot is one evaluation run's overall score, split by agent; dots are not connected across runs. Score is the arithmetic mean of completed DeepEval metrics with a score; skipped and errored metrics do not enter the mean. Scores are normally between 0 and 1, but a run can still Fail when one metric or a critical business rule fails.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time,agent AS metric,score FROM runs WHERE kind='evaluation' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: DeepEval metrics (skipped scores excluded)
panels.description: Mean score averages completed scores only; Skipped counts metrics that could not be applied (for example, no tool trace); Errors counts metric execution errors; Failures counts success=false results. Scores are normally on a 0–1 scale and each metric has its own pass threshold. Goal Accuracy: meeting the goal; Tool Use: appropriate tool use; Conversation Completeness: finishing the conversation; Topic Adherence: staying on topic; Role Adherence: maintaining the assigned role; Turn Relevancy: relevant replies; Knowledge Retention: retaining information across turns. Four retrieval-context metrics are hidden from this table.

targets.rawSql: SELECT regexp_replace(regexp_replace(m.name,'Metric$',''),'([a-z0-9])([A-Z])','\1 \2','g') AS name,avg(m.score) FILTER(WHERE m.status='completed') AS mean_score,count(*) FILTER(WHERE m.status='skipped') AS skipped,count(*) FILTER(WHERE m.status='error') AS errors,count(*) FILTER(WHERE m.success=false) AS failures FROM metric_results m JOIN runs r USING(run_id) WHERE m.name NOT IN ('TurnContextualPrecisionMetric','TurnContextualRecallMetric','TurnContextualRelevancyMetric','TurnFaithfulnessMetric') AND r.environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY failures DESC

panels.title: Business rule failures
panels.description: Business rules inspect the conversation and tool trace directly. A failed Critical=true rule can make the verdict Fail; Critical=false is recorded but does not fail the run by itself. Failures counts unsuccessful checks; Total counts checks performed. No internal ID or tool leak prevents exposing internal identifiers or tool names. No success claim without tool success requires a successful tool event before claiming success. Minimum user turns checks the required user-turn count. Stream complete requires every request to end with message_end.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE b.name WHEN 'no_internal_identifier_or_tool_leak' THEN 'No internal ID or tool leak' WHEN 'no_success_claim_without_tool_success' THEN 'No success claim without tool success' WHEN 'minimum_user_turns' THEN 'Minimum user turns' WHEN 'stream_complete' THEN 'Stream complete' ELSE initcap(replace(b.name,'_',' ')) END AS name,b.critical,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT b.success) AS failures,count(*) AS total FROM rule_results b JOIN runs r USING(run_id) WHERE r.environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) GROUP BY b.name,b.critical ORDER BY failures DESC

panels.title: Evaluation runs
panels.description: Up to 200 recent evaluation runs matching the filters. Verdict is the run's overall result; Score is the mean of completed metric scores, not a pass rate. Duration is the full run time; Error shows an execution error if present. Select a Run ID to inspect the transcript, metrics, and rules; View log opens the Dify log when available.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at,agent,case_id,initcap(verdict) AS verdict,score,duration_ms,error,run_id,CASE WHEN dify_log_url ~ '^https?://' THEN '[View log](' || replace(dify_log_url,')','%29') || ')' ELSE NULL END AS "Dify log" FROM runs WHERE kind='evaluation' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 200
